decisions.decision: Preserve T1/T2 exact bytes and use T3-O1 explicitly.
Use optional cryptography P256 SHA256 DER low-S statements, not a custom signature primitive.
Controller and simulated target use separate SQLite databases; durable intent, target CAS plus atomic idempotency ledger, and explicit reconciliation bridge the gap.
Evidence is recognized testimony over declared scope, not global discovery or a truth oracle.
Partial outcomes remain blocked for explicit recovery; no arbitrary production adapter or distributed atomic phase is admitted.
Per-source high-water sequence precedes age eligibility so expiry cannot revive superseded positives.
